Cover parse_records, format_records, to_json, and CLI behavior, including exact/missing/wrong headers, malformed quoting, wrong column counts, quoted commas, doubled quotes, embedded newlines, CRLF, Unicode, empty fields, record key and string-value validation, LF-only serialization, JSON string preservation, stdout/stderr separation, traceback suppression, and exit codes 0 and 2. The deliverable should be directly usable by the integration owner to verify the implementation against the fixed behavioral expectations.
